name: 97420 · Coos Bay, OR
findings: ZIP 97420 (Coos Bay) has 108 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97420 (Coos Bay) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
